name: BSP_VoiceManager_CanPlay
evidence: Hypothesis, not a recovered symbol. Packet mission_events_update, read-only analysis. bool __thiscall(this, const vector<Clip12>*), RET 4. ECX is [[00e198c4]+A4h] and the stack argument is warning+14h; the Ghidra decompiler prints 00987590's call with one argument and loses the ECX, so take the order from 0098768a..0098769a. Returns false unless [[00e188a8]+21E4h]+34h and +24h are both zero (the panel sequence manager, so radio lines are suppressed during a cutscene), voice+74h is zero and, for every clip, at least one of the two 18h-byte playback slots at voice+8h and voice+20h reports free through 007027b0. The returned value is SETZ on voice+6Ch at 005b727e. Clip count comes from 005b5df0, (_Mylast - _Myfirst) / 0Ch. | Provisional descriptive name, not recovered symbol. Voice_line_playback; verified assembly; ECX=manager; vector* stack; RET4. Correction superseding older evidence: CMP ESI,1/JL at 005B7251/54 scans only manager+8, not two slots. 007027B0 has side effects and is repeated per clip; manager+6C reread for return. Evidence: docs/VOICE_LINE_PLAYBACK.md; bounded host projection reconstructed and Win32 build-tested; not ABI/game-validated; Ghidra unchanged.

name: BSP_VoiceManager_PlayLine
evidence: Hypothesis, not a recovered symbol. Packet mission_events_update, read-only analysis. __thiscall(this, clipVector, arg, speakerEntity). Classifies the speaker into 0..4 from [game+18CCh + 4*game+18ECh]+28h against speaker+54h, with 2 accepted unconditionally, four virtual +5Ch probes selecting 1, 2 or 3, and 4 when the side does not match; the index picks a slot from this+A0h. Called from 00974070 with warning+68h as the speaker and from 005bbdc0 with none. | Provisional descriptive name, not recovered symbol. Voice_line_playback; verified assembly; ECX=manager; vector*, target dword, speaker* stack; RET0C. Five short-circuit vslot+5C kinds 8/1A/1B/19/6 choose categories 1/2/3; mismatch 4; default0. Null speaker selects null reference, not table[0]. Allocates 38h, constructs, appends nullable line. Evidence: docs/VOICE_LINE_PLAYBACK.md; bounded host projection reconstructed and Win32 build-tested; not ABI/game-validated; Ghidra unchanged.

name: BSP_VoiceManager_PlayPositionalLine
evidence: Hypothesis, not a recovered symbol. Packet mission_events_update, read-only analysis. Refreshes the camera transform at game+19FCh, takes the separation from the speaking entity through 0042b2f0 and forms (2000.0 - distance) / 2000.0 with the double at 00cf0dd8, playing through 005bbc10 with a null speaker only when the result is at least 0.25f (00ce3868) and above zero, i.e. inside 1500 m. Called from 00974070 when warning+50h is non-zero. | Provisional descriptive name, not recovered symbol. Voice_line_playback; verified assembly; ECX=manager; Clip12 by value then entity* stack; RET10. Record+8 signed ID gate; entity-camera float stores; x87 attenuation admission only, NaN accepted by JA/JNC with masked exceptions. Original clip word preserved; play(vector,0,0). Double host distance is not exact x87. Evidence: docs/VOICE_LINE_PLAYBACK.md; bounded host projection reconstructed and Win32 build-tested; not ABI/game-validated; Ghidra unchanged.
